name: slide-to-confirm
title: Slide to Confirm
description: A slide-to-commit control for irreversible actions: drag the thumb to the end, or press Enter, Space or the right arrow. Shows busy and done states.

props.name: label
props.description: What sliding does, e.g. 'Slide to send 0.25 ETH'.

props.name: confirmingLabel
props.description: Shown and announced while onConfirm runs.

props.name: doneLabel
props.description: Shown and announced once it is done.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: The real work. Return a promise to keep the spinner up until it settles; a rejection sends the thumb back.

props.name: resetAfter
props.description: Seconds before it returns to the start once done. null stays done.

props.name: duration
props.description: Minimum seconds the busy state shows.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
